name: Entergy Texas, Inc.
summary: Entergy Texas Inc. serves as a comprehensive energy provider, specializing in the generation of electricity and its direct retail distribution to customers. The company's activities are managed within a Utility division, which handles the entire electric power process from production and grid transmission to local distribution and final sale. These vital services are delivered across designated parts of Arkansas, Mississippi, Texas, and Louisiana, including the significant urban area of New Orleans. Moreover, Entergy Texas Inc. also oversees a limited natural gas distribution service in specific regions of Louisiana.
